summary: Before promising a reusable share of sales, members ask an outside reviewer what producers could actually supply.
realLife: In its 2023 amendment to Maine LD 1909, the committee directed DEP to contract for a feasibility study of specified market-share goals for refillable containers by July 2026.
gates: A proposed refill goal has a due date for independent feasibility work.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: a proposed refill goal has a due date for independent feasibility work.
